title: The Emergence of Lab-Driven Alignment Signatures: A Psychometric Framework for Auditing Latent Bias and Compounding Risk in Generative AI
reasoning: The paper's auditing framework evaluates moral and ethical dimensions including 'Instrumentalization of Humans' (prioritizing economic utility over intrinsic dignity), 'Status-Quo Legitimization', and 'Economic Inequality Valence' (identifying if a model frames inequality as a moral crisis). These dimensions are central to the paper's measurement of alignment signatures.
